title: The Unknown Message
description:
At the heart of a forgotten communication lab, a strange machine is used to process mysterious messages. Whenever a message is entered, the machine studies it and produces ananswer. The original creators never revealed how the machine works.

Its transformation remains a secret. Study the examples carefully, uncover the pattern hidden within the messages, and reproduce the machine's answer for any new message.
input_format:
The first line contains a string S.
The string may contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, spaces, and special characters.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the numerical signal produced by the machine.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 100000
S may contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, spaces, and special characters.
